สไลด์หนีภัย

An inflatable slide fitted to the ship’s side, designed for rapid evacuation of crew and passengers directly into the sea or a survival craft.

Definition

An inflatable slide fitted to the ship’s side, designed for rapid evacuation of crew and passengers directly into the sea or a survival craft.

Operational example

In case of evacuation order, all persons must proceed to the assigned escape slide station and prepare for rapid embarkation into liferafts.
